scope: A bounded nucleic-acid, interferon and B-cell circuit with a renal injury branch.

paragraphs.text: SLE immune complexes increased surface BLyS in healthy monocyte cultures. Self-reactive antibodies participate in nucleic-acid-containing immune complexes. Persistent apoptotic material was proposed as antigen for immune-complex formation.

These selected findings describe a bounded candidate, whose overall explanation has not been independently checked against current literature. Indirect route through monocytes; not direct IC–BAFF binding. Complex composition and delivery determine activity. Active SLE or active lupus nephritis in patients aged 5 years and older receiving standard therapy. US licensed indication. Drug targeting and approval do not establish every proposed mechanism or benefit in every phenotype.
